top_choice_rationale: A single-part B045 prize to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov rewards a complete, mature discovery chain (incretin physiology and GLP-1 action, proglucagon and receptor biology, identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide), with mechanism confirmed by large independent outcome trials. The attribution risk (Mojsov versus Habener, and Knudsen left out) is real but does not outweigh the strength of the achievement, and the citation can state the therapeutic consequence without crediting drug development. No award is clearly worse than this prize.
